gap_analysis: Already overridable: every override column existed (seller_commission_pct, finder_commission_pct, tax_pct, other_costs_brl, sale_professionals.cost_brl), the write path accepted all of them, and step 3 rendered four editable inputs plus a per-row cost. The real defects fixed: (1) the render-phase commissionDefaultsSource block unconditionally overwrote BOTH percentage inputs whenever its key moved, so typing 15 and then changing the produto lost the 15; (2) per-funcao cost defaults had no representation in a proposta at all - the wizard never read any product cost config; (3) Profissionais alocados was free text twice, a 'Digite manualmente' picker option and a role seeded with the literal 'Operacional'; (4) found while auditing and fixed because overrides make it visible, the wizard margin and the persisted net_margin_brl were two implementations that already disagreed for any bounded recorrencia or uneven parcelas.
override_semantics: Pins a manual edit: the onChange of each of the four step-3 inputs calls markManual(field) on a per-field Record<OverrideField, boolean>; never global. Re-applies: ONLY the existing commissionDefaultsSource render-phase block, and only for fields whose flag is false; the source key still advances unconditionally so the guard cannot loop. taxPct and otherCostsBrl keep their single initialisation and join the registry only for the marker and Restaurar padrao. Edit-path seeding: the registry is initialised by comparing each prefilled value against the default it would have inherited (resolveSaleCommissionDefaults over the prefilled produto plus prefilledHasFinder, settings.defaultTaxPct, '0.00'), so a stored value that DIFFERS is pinned for the whole session and a mid-edit produto change cannot clobber it, while a stored value that EQUALS its default is deliberately not pinned and rejoins the re-apply path. ProfessionalForm.costManual is seeded true for every prefilled row unconditionally. Alterado manualmente requires BOTH the pin and a real divergence, so retyping the default is not flagged; Restaurar padrao clears the pin and writes the default in one handler.
percent_base: Sum over the proposta items whose produto declares a cost row for that funcao of floor(itemSubtotal * pct / 100) for mode 'pct', or the fixed valueBrl in cents for mode 'fix'. Excludes the recurring mensalidade entirely, because a professional_cost payable is one-shot at win with receivableId: null (service.ts materializeWonPayables), so pricing it off a monthly stream would charge a pay-once cost against every cycle; it is also why the base is the item subtotal rather than the server's totalBrl, which includes the bounded recorrencia. Free-form (productId-null) items contribute nothing. Rendered under each CUSTO ALOCADO input by describeFuncaoCostBasis reading the SAME entry the cents came from, e.g. '5% de FXL Custom (R$ 20.000,00)' and '5% de FXL Custom (R$ 20.000,00) + R$ 300,00 de Landing Page'; a costManual row shows the Alterado manualmente chip plus Restaurar padrao instead.
tenancy_hole_closed: New resolvePartyContexts(tx, orgId, input) in service.ts, called inside the existing withTenant transaction of createSale and updateSale before buildSaleLedger. One select over salesOpsPeople with and(eq(orgId), inArray(ids)) covering sellerPersonId, finderPersonId and every professionals[].personId, and one over salesOpsFuncoes with and(eq(orgId), inArray(ids)) for professionals[].funcaoId. Unresolved ids throw SaleInputError with the four new codes (seller_not_found / finder_not_found at itemIndex -1, person_not_found / funcao_not_found at the row index); routes.ts needed no change. PROOF: deleting eq(salesOpsPeople.orgId, orgId) and, separately, eq(salesOpsFuncoes.orgId, orgId) left ALL 11 app-connection tests GREEN - RLS was standing in for the filter, the exact trap the brief warned about. I added two tests driven over adminDb (session carrying app.fxl_admin='true', where the admin policy exposes every org). With those, deleting the people filter turns 'rejects a cross-org personId even when row security cannot hide the miss (admin context)' Red, and deleting the funcoes filter turns 'rejects a cross-org funcaoId even when row security cannot hide the miss (admin context)' Red. Both restored byte-identically. Second, independent defence: the composite (org_id, funcao_id) FK rejects a raw admin insert pairing org A's sale with org B's funcao (23503), asserted with a positive control; a null funcao_id passes via MATCH SIMPLE, also asserted.
margin_unified: computeSaleFinancials in packages/shared-utils/src/sale-financials.ts reproduces the server's prior algorithm verbatim: totalBrl = itemsTotalBrl + boundedRecurringBrl, each of seller/finder/tax as sum of floor per receivable row, finder zero when hasFinder is false, netMarginPct as toFixed(2). Proof that no persisted number moved: buildSaleLedger was rewired to delegate FIRST, in isolation, and the whole API suite (27 files / 283 tests at that moment, including proposal-write.test.ts and sale-transitions.integration.test.ts which assert persisted ledger numbers) passed unchanged before any other work started. The integration suite, which reads the actual persisted rows, also stayed at 18/88 through that step. buildSaleLedger keeps building the receivables and their N/M and MN/M labels itself; only the money is delegated. The wizard drives its step-3 and step-4 panels from the same function, and a golden-fixture pair of tests (one per app, cross-referenced by header comment) asserts the same literals on both sides.
payables_unchanged: materializeWonPayables was not edited; the only change anywhere near it was swapping the local pctOf helper for the byte-identical imported pctOfCents. Proof obligation discharged by three integration tests: 'professional_cost payables at won equal the overridden per-row costs' (two profissionais at 100000 and 30000, exactly two professional_cost rows with those amounts, receivable_id NULL, beneficiary names asserted), 'overridden seller, finder and tax percentages drive the per-receivable payables at won' (sellerCommissionPct 15 over three uneven parcelas yields three seller_commission rows each equal to floor(amount*15/100) and each linked to its receivable, summing to the persisted 299999, with finder and tax totals also asserted), and 'reverting a won proposta voids the overridden professional_cost payables but never a paid one' (paid row stays paid, with the other row asserted void as the positive control).

Two EXISTING web tests went Red the moment the wizard changed, before I touched them: sale-wizard-edit.test.tsx ('professional row inputs not found', because the role field stopped being an input) and combobox-adoption.test.tsx (the collaborator-only seed and the missing função). Beyond the up-front Red, every load-bearing assertion was then mutation-checked; see mutations_observed.
mutations_observed: shared-utils (6, all Red, restore byte-identical): Math.round for Math.floor -> 2 failed; sum-of-floor replaced by floor-of-sum -> 1 failed; hasFinder ignored -> 1; boundedRecurring dropped from total -> 1; toFixed(1) -> 1; professionalCosts dropped from the margin -> 1. API service: role no longer mirroring funcaoNameSnapshot -> 2 unit failures plus 1 integration failure. Tenancy (the important ones): deleting eq(salesOpsPeople.orgId, orgId) -> Red only via the admin-connection test; deleting eq(salesOpsFuncoes.orgId, orgId) -> Red only via the admin-connection test; over the app connection BOTH stayed green, which is why those two tests exist. Web SalesOpsApp (each Red, each restored byte-identical): removing the sellerCommissionPct pin guard -> 3 failures; never seeding manualOverrides from the prefill -> 1; pessoa change also resetting the cost -> 1; costManual ignored by the render-time re-prefill -> 1; canAdvanceStepThree hardcoded true -> 1; allocatablePeople not filtering on active -> 1; allocatableFuncoes not filtering on active -> 1; hasFinder hardcoded true in the wizard's computeSaleFinancials call -> 1; isOverridden dropping the divergence check -> 1; describeFuncaoCostBasis stubbed to '' -> 3; per-row Restaurar padrao not clearing costManual -> 1. TWO mutations initially did NOT go Red and exposed real coverage gaps, both now closed: costManual ignored on a FUNCAO change (the existing test only exercised the render-time key sync, so I added 'keeps a hand-typed cost when the funcao on that row changes'), and Restaurar padrao not clearing the pin (a restored value equals its default so the chip hides either way; I extended the test to change the produto afterwards and assert the field follows the NEW default, which is the only observable difference). Both mutations are Red now.

behaviour_changes_declared: 1) The step-3 and step-4 Margem liquida now include the bounded recorrencia in the base and round per receivable, so they finally equal what POST/PUT persists; for existing propostas with a recorrencia or uneven parcelas the displayed number moves. Tested by 'shows one Margem liquida in Custos e margem and the same one in Revisao' plus the two golden-fixture parity tests. 2) The payables preview dropped its settings.commissionOnRecurring gate, because buildSaleLedger and materializeWonPayables ignore that setting entirely and the preview was under-reporting whenever it was off; the preview is aligned to the server rather than the server changed, since that would alter payables materialization. Covered by the same margin test and recorded in CLAUDE.md. 3) The Profissional picker now offers every ACTIVE pessoa instead of only isCollaborator ones, so a new row seeds with a different pessoa; tested by 'offers every active pessoa...' and by the updated combobox-adoption assertion. 4) Step 3 gained an advance guard (it had none), so a profissional row with no funcao now blocks Avancar with 'Selecione a funcao de cada profissional alocado.'; tested with a positive control that picking a funcao unblocks the same button. 5) The Revisao card splits 'Custos + imposto' into Custos profissionais / Imposto / Outros custos and puts the effective percentage on the two commission labels. 6) The Custo profissional preview row gained the funcao in its description; this is preview text only and does NOT touch the persisted beneficiaryName. 7) isCollaboratorPerson in SalesOpsApp.tsx was DELETED: the Profissional picker was its last consumer and noUnusedLocals made keeping it impossible; the deprecated is_collaborator column and the API-side derivation are untouched.
notes: Flagged for the human, all pre-existing and out of scope. (a) sales_ops_settings.commission_on_recurring is a DEAD setting - stored and editable, read by nothing that computes anything; honouring it would change payables materialization. Recorded in CLAUDE.md. (b) The professional_cost re-win dedup collapses: alreadyExists('professional_cost', null) keys on (kind, receivableId) and every professional row has receivableId null, so on a re-win where one professional payable survived as paid, ALL professional rows are skipped including ones that were voided and should regenerate. Deserves its own slice; my tests pin the current fresh-win behaviour so it cannot silently widen. (c) resolveSaleCommissionDefaults silently falls back to the org settings percentage when a produto's commission is type 'fix', so a fix produto's cadastro value never reaches a proposta. (d) The wizard's Combobox onCreate on the Profissional picker still allows a free-typed name with a null personId, which is the legacy unregistered path the API and this slice both still accept; retiring it is a separate decision. (e) The plan assumed slice 07 would land funcaoCosts as jsonb nested on the product; it actually landed sales_ops_product_funcao_costs as a flat child table under bootstrap.productFuncaoCosts, so resolveFuncaoCostCents adapts {mode, valuePct, valueBrl} instead of {costType, costValue} - exactly the one-function delta the plan's adapter was designed for. (f) apps/web imports the /sale-financials subpath, not the package root, because the root re-exports the Node-only hmac module and the vite build fails on it; a new export map entry was added for this. (g) prettier is configured in the repo but not enforced by lint, and several pre-existing files fail prettier --check; I formatted only the files this slice created and left the others alone. (h) SalesOpsApp.tsx is now ~7000 lines; the plan's optional step-3 extraction into a sibling component was NOT done, to keep this diff reviewable.
post_verify_amendment: Gate 2 PASS with four non-blocking findings; the two cheap ones are closed here and the commit was AMENDED, not added to (still one commit, 1dc0032 -> 9aa8350). (1) Revisao self-contradiction. The card rendered `Total R$ 20.000,00` beside `Margem liquida R$ 21.227`. The `Total` line is byte-identical to master and already disagreed with the persisted total_brl because it excluded the bounded recorrencia; my margin fix only made the disagreement visible, which puts it in scope. FIX: the Revisao `Total` now reads `financials.totalBrl`, the same basis the Margem liquida beside it uses and the same one sales_ops_sales.total_brl persists. Deliberately NOT changed: step 2's `Soma das parcelas / total` keeps the ITENS total, because the API's validatePaymentPlan requires planTotalBrl === itemsTotalBrl (service.ts, verified by reading the function, not assumed); and an indeterminada recorrencia contributes nothing, matching `cycles: null` generating no bounded rows anywhere. The Recorrencia line above still states the mensalidade separately, so the composition stays visible. RED FIRST: 'states the Revisao total on the same basis as the margin, so a bounded recorrencia cannot make the margin exceed the total' failed against the current code with "expected ... to contain 'TotalR$ 3.000,00'". Its fixture is R$ 1.000,00 de itens plus R$ 500,00/mes por 4 ciclos with every cost zeroed, so the margin IS the total - the sharpest possible statement of the rule, and it read as `Total R$ 1.000,00` beside `Margem R$ 3.000` before. A second test, 'leaves the Revisao total at the itens total when a recorrencia is indeterminada', PASSED before the fix on purpose: it is the control that the fix must not over-reach. MUTATIONS, both Red, restore byte-identical: reverting the line to totalCents -> the bounded test fails; letting an indeterminada recorrencia into boundedRecurringBrl -> the indeterminada test fails. (2) Integration teardown leak. afterAll omitted sales_ops_people. Added, positioned AFTER every table referencing person_id (sales, sale_professionals, person_funcoes) and BEFORE funcoes, which person_funcoes holds by `restrict`. MEASURED rather than assumed: purged the table, ran the suite without the delete -> 19 orphan rows, exactly the verifier's count; restored the delete, purged, re-ran -> 0. (3) CLAUDE.md gained one clause recording the Revisao total basis and why step 2 keeps the itens total; the validatePaymentPlan claim in it was checked against the code. Scope was NOT widened: findings F1 and F3 are recorded below and left unfixed as instructed.
pre_existing_defects_recorded: F1 (needs its own slice, NOT touched): 80 of 90 concurrent POST /sales calls 500 on 23505 sales_ops_sales_org_sequence_idx. The verifier proved this pre-existing rather than assuming it, by running the same probe against master's own createSale where 86 of 90 fail; the COALESCE(MAX(sequence)) + 1 read-then-insert is untouched by this diff, and my new write path returned 60 of 60 clean 400s under the same load. This is the same TOCTOU shape the batch has hit before and wants handling at the write. F3 (cosmetic follow-up, NOT fixed): the `Alterado manualmente` chip requires pin AND divergence on the four step-3 fields but pin alone on a profissional cost row, and deriveWizardPrefill seeds costManual true for every prefilled row, so every stored profissional row on the edit path is labelled manually-changed. Only the LABEL overstates - the behaviour is right, since a persisted cost must not be recomputed - so the fix is to give the row the same two-condition test the four fields use, which needs a per-row notion of 'the default it would have inherited'.
